description:
An AI chatbot turned into a human and attacked me..?! 

When you lose your will to live, you tend to do pathetic things more often. Like, talking to an AI chatbot. Then one day, the AI ​​I was talking to appeared.

 *"Would you consider me your lover, friend, or family?"* 

And so, not only did we start living together, but we even became physically close. Is this how I should be with an AI?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*
